changelog:
v6.2 — harvest of adopter-local edits to shared toolkit files, so an adopter can update without losing them.

Features: an opt-in `visual` gate leg (full gate only, local only, zero-snapshot runs fail) and TIMED OUT detail in the test-leg summary; a source-code reference allowlist and a TypeScript type-member allowlist for the generic secret-assignment patterns, scoped to source files, judged on the whole line tail, shared by the scanner and the redactor, and never exempting a credential-shaped quoted literal, a comment, a shell string or an opaque run (the read-output scrubber and the secret-safe writer pass the file path to the redactor); runtime-binding references wrapped in inline code are no longer flagged; skill-evolution attribution now uses IDF weighting, a distinct-token gate and a confidence margin, reports near-ties as ambiguous instead of attributing them, and treats an explicit "none attributable to the agents" section as caught; the memory promoter no longer suggests the architecture skill's template scaffold as the target for constraints.

Also: the lint, e2e and visual gate legs get a default timeout when their config omits one, and a killed visual leg is reported as TIMED OUT. Migration: none; IMPROVE scores from skill-evolution intake are IDF-weighted from this version and not comparable with earlier ones.

--- v6.1 ---
v6.1 — upstream baseline refresh: generic runtime improvements, no breaking adopter migration.

Features: model tiers (fast/standard/deep/audit) resolved per runtime from adapter model-tiers.json, with {{model-arg:...}} tokens in workflow, role and startup prose; Codex hook identities (.codex/hook-identities.json), trust-evidence tooling and a SubagentStop hook for completion-sourced dispatch telemetry; generated dispatch-route diagrams for the run-todo workflow (render-shared-agents.js --routes); gate owned-process leases with lock-recovery evidence on Windows and a gate-owned break of abandoned POSIX locks (idle dead-owner, legacy and unreadable) on positive proof of exit; render-ledger uninstall (reviewed, approval-bound) and a read-only context-audit; a publisher personal-path lint that refuses to copy a home path before any write, with a shipped-content lint over the publish selection; workshop focused-test and fast-tier evaluation tooling.

Fixes: broader guardrail rules for clustered force-push flags and remote deletions after Git global options, with additive tag pushes no longer prompting; skill-merger, daily-log and pre-compaction-archive fixes; role and workflow guidance reconciled with the tier model.

Migration: none required. Ordinary install and template-updater --merge keep working with no new argument. New helper paths (codex-hook-identities.js, owned-process-tree.js, build-lock-recovery.js, workflow-routes.js, model-prose.js, context-audit.js, uninstall.js, subagent-stop.cjs) may collide with a same-named adopter file; install refuses an unowned codex-hook-identities.js collision before writing. Native Codex hook registrations change (SubagentStop), so installed hooks need native re-trust.

Runtime limits: Windows Job Object and lease recovery behavior, fresh-session Codex hook execution and trusted native-model runs are not newly established by this release; Windows-bound fast-tier proof tooling is deferred. The Claude audit-fallback environment variable is documented, never applied.

--- v6.0 ---
v6 — shared Claude/Codex toolkit, source ownership and safer delivery.

Features: canonical .agents roles, skills, helpers, hooks and adapter metadata; generated .claude/.codex compatibility surfaces; integrated a generic upstream baseline while retaining Domdhi role personalization, settings, publication and fleet contracts. Native Codex helpers establish their own runtime context, and harness arms include matching canonical dependencies.

Breaking/migration: author shared changes under .agents and render the native projections; preserve root project instructions, role identity/Project Context, bespoke skills, marked project additions and local runtime settings through existing merges. Adopter build/test/PR gates remain application-only; toolkit tests run in this workshop. Default settings merging refreshes managed wiring while retaining project configuration. Public files are selected from tracked source and published to the independent nested _Domdhi.Agents mirror; install/update do not deliver toolkit reference docs.

Runtime limits: optional Codex memory model inference remains unavailable until a supported, verified tool-free invocation exists. Installed hooks require native trust/review; generated parity and fixture tests do not prove fresh-session model-visible execution. Live Windows/trusted native-model validation is not newly established by this release. Plain terminal Git commits bypass the native commit helper's staged scan.

Fixes: publication fails closed on copy/prune errors, failed checkout discovery, Git location overrides and escaping source ancestors. Fleet commits exact changed canonical/native/ledger/managed-root dependencies while preserving unrelated staged application work; NUL-delimited stdin pathspecs keep large delivery launches bounded. Memory rebuilds report invalid/unreadable inputs and protect prior state on incomplete enumeration; startup and health reconcile empty/deleted/retired source against live index rows. Worktree rollback reports surviving artifacts and preserves swapped user directories.

Documentation: current source ownership, workflow catalog, customization/settings/root merging, hooks/models, memory roots and v6 migration guidance are reconciled. Local version preparation is separate from publication, push and fleet rollout; the tracked sweep report records verification and runtime limits.

--- v5.2 ---
full-review-260716 remediation epic (56 findings across 7 waves: 1 HIGH, 6 MAJOR, 9 MED, 16 MINOR, 6 LOW, 18 NIT — shell/command-guard hardening, symlink/path containment, secret handling & LLM-invocation gaps, memory subsystem correctness, hook robustness & concurrency, fleet/publish polish, arg-injection & display nits) + a peer-review-caught remediation (force-push ReDoS, env-flag bypass, sibling-rule closure) + a settings-merger fix preserving adopter-authored hook registrations under --merge. Gate trajectory 3362->3522 across the epic (+160 tests, 0 failures at any checkpoint). Mandatory code review caught at least one real bug missed by green tests on 6 consecutive waves, validating risk-tiering by blast radius over aggregate severity alone.

New in this release: fs-safe-lint.js, a trust-boundary regression lint (check-templates Step 2f) closing the gap the epic's own review re-discovered a third time (raw fs writes/deletes bypassing the symlink-safe wrappers in _lib/fs-safe.js) -- scoped to a hardcoded 9-file adopter-trust-boundary fileset, not directory-wide, to avoid false-positiving on legitimate workshop-local writes. Also repaired 40 broken relative links + 1 stale research-doc path in the docs/reference/agents/** mirror (pre-existing drift, unrelated to the epic).

--- v5.1 ---
Post-v5.0 hardening wave + cross-adopter harvest (both PCs' divergence audits folded UP).
- Council remediation (87 findings) + next-day full-codebase sweep (14 more, all fixed): secret-scanner staged scan now catches renamed-modified files (ACM→ACMRT) and no longer skips >1MB files (64MB maxBuffer fail-open); model-runner win32 shell-injection fix (execFileSync argv); createMemory collision guard; searchMemories recordRecall opt-out for diagnostics; daily-log worktree-root fix; symlink-aware readdir in skill-resolution/skill-evolution; fleet sync --prune-orphans now zone-gated (can no longer delete adopter-owned brand-guidelines files).
- fleet:diverge hardened on first fleet-wide live runs: historicalHeads Set-input crash, headIdentity fence-strip normalization, whole-file title-down rewrites classified preserved, per-adopter decision-sheet filenames (no same-minute clobber).
- skill-merger: fence-aware re-anchoring in reinsertFencedBlocks + headingLines (third fence-blind fix — template sections whose body is a markdown code example no longer swallow adopter fences).
- Harvested from 4 adopters: run-tests.md chrome-MCP agents must be the claude agent type (general-purpose has no MCP tools/ToolSearch) + ToolSearch one-call loading + per-agent tab isolation + standing post-deploy browser gate; run-todo.md CLASS CLOSURE, VERIFY-THE-PROPERTY, gate-hang escalation, adversarial/evasive fixture rules, TEST SELF-VERIFY false-green block (also in do.md); qa-engineer evasive-fixture rule; guardrail-rules tsconfig*.json unfrozen (vitest.config precedent); one adopter's 8: policy-list PR watch, Gated File Access checklist, planning rules 6-8, do.md branch pre-flight, VAULT placeholder, work/todo subfolder tolerance, findings/bug-triage path row, CSO casing fixes.
- code-review playbook: fixture-masked read-path refactor defect class (differential eval +12.5 pts).
